prompt: I just cloned my project and want to set up opencode-coder for the first time. Run /opencode-coder/init and walk me through what should happen. This is a fresh repo with no prior opencode-coder setup.
assertions: Explains that fresh projects are not yet enabled until the user explicitly chooses a mode
Offers stealth versus team as the mode choice and explains the difference
Explains that startup must not create .coder/ or other artifacts before explicit enablement
Mentions .coder/opencode-coder.yaml as where the saved mode lives
Explains at least one concrete stealth-versus-team path or git-visibility difference
